scope: 300 seen training songs; frozen benchmark probes; one evaluation sampling seed

baseline.probe_coverage_note: prior global AR had piano_three, piano_weak_middle and silence; repeated/boundary were missing

contract.input: raw cropped waveform, both translated views re-encoded
contract.label: all four types; complete Holds; physical sample clock, then original tick quantization
contract.negative: same content, same duration/BPM/mask, different physical time shift
contract.shift_overlap: less than 50 percent of unique onsets matched at 25 ms
contract.diagnostic_scope: new transformations of three trained songs; not unseen songs

pair_cache.preparation_source_note: Hold duration preservation was corrected after preparation; all 606 view targets were recomputed and confirmed exactly equal, so cache remained valid

config.formula: original song-mean CE; separate silence EOS optimizer step every ten songs
config.attribution: reference-free time-token adaptation inspired by CoPO; not mDPO reproduction
config.inference: unchanged global attention, temperature=1, top_p=.95, no repair or threshold changes

config.formula: joint token CE + weight * mean_bidirectional softplus(-beta * (mean_DT_logp_correct - mean_DT_logp_wrong))
config.attribution: reference-free time-token adaptation inspired by CoPO; not mDPO reproduction
config.inference: unchanged global attention, temperature=1, top_p=.95, no repair or threshold changes

config.attribution: reference-free time-token adaptation inspired by CoPO; not mDPO reproduction

limitations: data and rank share samples/order/updates/positive-dropout; continued has 330 versus 300 updates per epoch
same weight initialization; fresh AdamW and common schedule restart, not uninterrupted optimizer continuation
ranking is reference-free mean DT likelihood adaptation, not full mDPO
shift diagnostics are new transformations of seen songs, not independent songs
whole-clip translation chiefly changes initial DT; a likelihood gap does not prove free timing follows audio
onset F1/grid bonus do not validate note types, layout or playability
zero acoustic features are not digital silence; both ablations and encoded true silence are reported separately
